"""Fixture (a): plain constant metadata block."""

from agent_workflows import artifact_meta

# Preserved comment line for byte-preservation checks.
UNTOUCHED_MARKER = "keep-me-intact"


def test_plain_constant_plan_parses() -> None:
    text = (
        "# IPD: Plain Constant Plan\n\n"
        "- Id: pl1001\n"
        "- Status: approved\n"
        "- Set: demo\n"
        "- Order: 1\n"
    )
    st = artifact_meta.read_text(text, record_type="ipd")
    assert st.id6 == "pl1001"
    assert st.status == "approved"
    assert st.fields["set"] == "demo"
    assert st.fields["order"] == "1"
    assert UNTOUCHED_MARKER == "keep-me-intact"
